Definitions.__EMPTY: Must‑have / Activation & Trust driver (near‑term business impact)
Uses existing system state and values for display and interaction only. No backend data aggregation, rules, thresholds, interpretation, or decisioning.

Uses existing datasets with backend handling such as aggregation, correlation, rules, or thresholds. May also include new datasets sourced via external APIs, but no prediction, learning, or optimization logic.

Uses data plus decisioning logic to recommend, automate, predict, or optimize outcomes.
Includes:
- Business‑logic algorithms (rules, heuristics, deterministic logic)
- R&D‑level algorithms (product based optimizations, etc.)
